subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Which proposed memory roles and per-agent semantics should become permanent public plugin/config API in this release?
rationale: The patch establishes long-lived role names, fallback rules, and SDK semantics; source correctness cannot decide whether all five roles are mature enough to publish or whether generic slot-owner records should be the eventual abstraction.

options.title: Publish stable roles only
options.body: Approve a narrowed set of roles with complete current invocation contracts and defer the remaining selectors until their protocols exist.

options.title: Publish the full role foundation
options.body: Approve all five role selectors and per-agent inheritance now, with explicit documentation of current lifecycle limitations.

options.title: Converge on generic ownership
options.body: Pause this branch and carry its useful runtime work into generic slot-owner records once that proposal is proof-positive and viable.

recommendation.title: Publish stable roles only
recommendation.body: Approve a narrowed set of roles with complete current invocation contracts and defer the remaining selectors until their protocols exist.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history covers the broadest combination of plugin slots, config contracts, loader behavior, and agent-isolated memory state relevant to this product/API choice.
